text:
Priya Singh: Kickoff \u2014 pre-registration & benchmark narrative planning for the May webinar (working title: 'Inference Economics: Practical Playbook'). Goal: maximize signup velocity + make the bench story believable.
Maria Chen: Two hero claims to test: (A) cost savings story, (B) SLA/latency story. We'll A/B by audience segment.
Alex Park: Distribution plan: segmented email, LinkedIn ads, dev community posts (Discourse/Reddit), GitHub Discussions outreach, and an invite to our Slack. Keep paid budget focused on platform-eng and managers.
Jonah Lee: Bench narrative note: avoid %s alone. Use an absolute baseline + delta. Example micro-story: 'Acme reduced per-query cost from $0.90 -> $0.32 per 1M tokens while keeping p95 < 350ms.'
Priya Singh: Draft subject lines (will produce 3 per audience):
```
Subjects:
- Engs: "How Acme cut LLM inference cost by 65% — live workshop"
- Managers: "Reduce inference spend by 3x without retraining"
- Platform leads: "SLA-friendly LLM serving patterns — hands-on lab"
```
Taryn Cole: Preview text variants: short benefit line vs technical hook. We'll run a 2x2 test (subject x preview text). Also prepare one plain-text invite for developer channels.
Maria Chen: Proposed email cadence (10 days):
```
1) Day 0 - Invite: hero claim + single bench callout + register CTA
2) Day 5 - Reminder: speaker names + one bench stat + lab tease
3) Day 9 - Last call: urgency + poll tease + register CTA
```
Samir Patel: I'll own the lab sandboxes and the reproducible bench script. Plan: two repo flavors (cost-first, fidelity-first) + a bench harness that emits p50/p95 and cost per 1M tokens.
Alex Park: Rehearsal windows: full run May 20, tech-check May 23. @calendar-bot please create events and include recording/greenroom details.
calendar-bot: Event created: "May 20 Full Rehearsal" and "May 23 Tech Check" 10:00 PT. Recording enabled; greenroom link attached.
Priya Singh: Tracking: UTM campaign = webinar_inference_playbook_v1. Metrics to track: CTR on invite, registration rate, attendee role split, demo-repo picks, follow-up CTAs (cost estimate / trial / AE request).
Jonah Lee: Quick bench prelims (median of 7 runs): baseline -> median p50=120ms, p95=510ms, cost=$0.90 per 1M tokens; optimized -> median p50=85ms, p95=320ms, cost=$0.32 per 1M tokens. I'll upload CSV + raw runs to shared folder.
Maria Chen: Good. Use a short micro-claim on the landing page: "Cut inference cost by ~65% while meeting p95 targets" and link to a one-slide bench footnote with exact numbers.
Taryn Cole: Creative direction: Hero A = dashboard visual showing cost delta; Hero B = code + terminal overlay with latency numbers. We'll test both on the landing page and in ads.
Priya Singh: Landing page copy variants: technical (for engineers) vs outcome (for execs). We'll map audiences via form field "role" and route accordingly.
Samir Patel: Fallback policy for live demos: pre-record short clips for every live demo, prepare pre-seeded response JSONL (10 canonical outputs per scenario), and a 2-step swap runbook (producer swaps share link + host walks through recorded output).
Jonah Lee: Also recommend including a small table on the bench slide:
```
Prompt set | Baseline p95 | Optimized p95 | Baseline $/1M | Optimized $/1M
Short chat  | 490ms       | 310ms         | $0.85        | $0.30
Long form   | 530ms       | 340ms         | $0.95        | $0.35
```
Priya Singh: Speakers needed + assets by May 15: 2-paragraph bio, headshot, 60-90s fallback clip. Proposed slate: Maria (host), Samir (ops playbook), Carla (customer case), Jonah (bench brief).
Alex Park: Also prepare 3 short demo repos (cost-saver, fidelity-config, bench-harness) and a README with quick start. DevRel-bot: spin up CI job to build demo images.
DevRel-bot: Building demo images and bench harness. ETA 48h. Will post artifacts when ready.
Taryn Cole: Paid channel copy: 3 LinkedIn headlines, 2 short X posts, 1 Hacker News blurb (tech-first). I'll draft and post variants for approval by EOD.
Priya Singh: Measurement & follow-up plan: segment nurture based on role + demo preference; >5M tokens -> AE flag; demo preference = cost -> cost-estimate CTA in post-webinar email.
Maria Chen: Locking this plan unless objections. Next steps owners: Priya = subject lines + landing page copy; Jonah = bench CSV + raw data; Samir = sandboxes + swap runbook; Taryn = creative variants; calendar-bot events set. Backchannel if anything changes. :rocket:
